verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring workflows is a fair question for a cloud phone and automation platform, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows one-off actions (launching or pausing campaigns via API, sequential power dialing), business-hours routing schedules, and event-driven webhooks. None of these is a documented recurring job or workflow scheduler, and business-hours routing is an adjacent control, not scheduled automation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
